title: Payment & Currency System
short_description: Learn how payment systems determine currency combinations, calculate change, analyze payment possibilities, search denominations efficiently, and process transactions in arrival order.

real_world_context.problem: A payment system needs to determine how different currency denominations can be used to reach target amounts, calculate change efficiently, search supported denominations, analyze possible currency combinations, and process incoming transactions in the order they are received.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient currency calculations, searching, and transaction processing allow payment systems to handle large numbers of payments accurately and respond quickly to customer requests.

learning_objectives: Understand how currency denominations can be represented using arrays.
Apply Coin Change techniques to determine the minimum number of coins required for a target amount.
Apply Greedy algorithms to calculate currency change using available denominations.
Use Dynamic Programming to calculate the number of possible currency combinations.
Apply Binary Search to quickly locate the first denomination greater than or equal to a target amount.
Understand FIFO behavior and apply Queue Operations to process payment transactions.
Choose appropriate algorithms based on the type of payment or currency-processing requirement.
Understand why algorithm efficiency matters when processing large numbers of payments and transactions.

real_world_mapping.payment: Amount that needs to be paid or processed
real_world_mapping.coin: Individual currency unit used to construct an amount
real_world_mapping.denomination: Value assigned to a coin or currency note
real_world_mapping.target_amount: Payment amount that needs to be formed
real_world_mapping.change: Amount returned to a customer after a payment
real_world_mapping.payment_combination: A combination of denominations used to form an amount
real_world_mapping.transaction: Payment operation waiting to be processed
real_world_mapping.transaction_queue: Queue containing payment transactions in their arrival order

completion_message: You have completed the Payment & Currency System mission. You have learned how Coin Change, Greedy algorithms, Dynamic Programming, Binary Search, and Queue Operations can be applied to currency calculation, payment processing, and transaction management.
